title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.  

  

Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.  

  

The Merchant In\-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in\-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro\-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager\-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day\-to\-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.  

  

You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In\-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long\-term Merchant In\-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350\+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store\-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.  

  

As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data\-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI\-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define and evangelize the long\-term vision for Merchant In\-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in\-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000\+ stores by 2028


  

* Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant\-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro\-markets, kiosks, grab\-and\-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self\-service recovery mechanisms


  

* Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end\-to\-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets


  

* Own the JWO In\-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day\-to\-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout\-free environment


  

* Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, enterprise\-grade in\-store operations capabilities, making technical decisions that balance merchant needs across diverse verticals (Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, Hospitality) with engineering constraints, platform stability, and the ability to support stores with vastly different physical layouts and operational requirements


  

* Own the operational playbook for unattended store formats, defining standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and automated remediation workflows that ensure consistent store uptime and customer experience across geographies and merchant types


  

* Define and track key metrics including store uptime, mean\-time\-to\-resolution, associate task completion rates, planogram accuracy, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product investment decisions


  

* Build and maintain relationships with enterprise customers and cross\-functional stakeholders, gathering requirements from merchants operating at scale, understanding in\-store operational constraints, and ensuring Merchant In\-Store Operations capabilities meet current needs while anticipating future requirements as the business scales globally

Diverse Experiences: Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance: We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture: AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth: We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

**Who We Are:**
Gameberry Labs, a thriving mobile games studio established in 2017 and headquartered in Bangalore, has aimed for an extraordinary vision – to become the premier game development company on a global scale. As a bootstrapped and profitable startup, Gameberry Labs has taken the mobile gaming scene by storm. Since our inception in 2017, our games 'Ludo STAR' and 'Parchisi STAR' have captivated players around the globe, resulting in an impressive 300M\+ downloads. **Our Belief:**
Our profound belief in the transformative ability of mobile games lies in their power to reshape modern connections, entertainment, and learning experiences. We see them as personal buddies that boost our brains, melt away stress, and keep spirits high \- anytime, anywhere. **Our Mission:**
We want to make millions of people happy with games that they would love to grow old with. We are driven by passion for creating exceptional gaming experiences that people will cherish for years to come. With our fearless team of dreamers and innovators we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of mobile gaming. **Highlight Reel:*** We’ve smashed through 300M\+ game downloads — and counting!
* Our games have pulled in a whopping $275M\+ in lifetime revenue
* Over 15M\+ players jump into our worlds every single month
* Both Parchisi STAR and Ludo STAR have each crossed the 120M\+ download mark — absolute legends in their own right
* Crowned Bootstrap Champ at the ET Startups Awards 2023
* Dropped our latest hit “Sorry World” in Oct 2025 — hit \#1 on the US Play Store in just 2 weeks!
* Oh, and yes — we’ve handled 1M\+ players online at once without breaking a sweat

 **Cool Tidbits:*** Our games attract a monthly player base equivalent to the population of


Australia, with over 20M players engaging each month!* Players spend an astronomical 297\.6 Mars Round Trips worth of time on our


games daily!!! **About the role:**
We're building a new\-games engine, and this role owns it. It exists to do something structurally different from what made us successful so far: instead of deepening one enduring title, it puts many concepts into the market quickly, reads the signal honestly, and doubles down only on what earns it. We run this as a factory, not a series of bets. Concepts move through a staged funnel — creative signal, then install economics, then engagement, then ROAS — and most of them die at a stage. That is the point. The ones that survive get built into hybrid\-casual titles: ads\-led at the core, with a meta layer engineered to carry IAP as the game matures. You'll own that engine end to end. **What You'll Own** **Vision**. Set the thesis for what we build and why. Decide which mechanics, genres,
and audiences we chase this quarter and which we deliberately ignore. Turn
market signal — competitive intel, store movement, creative trends, UA data —
into a portfolio strategy leadership can back. **Product**. Own the full lifecycle on titles in the pipeline: concept, prototype, soft
launch, scale. Write the specs, design the core loop and progression, define the
economy, and shape the meta layer that takes a title from ad\-monetized to
hybrid. **Production**. Own throughput. Small pods, tight cadence, external partners where it
makes sense. You are accountable for how many concepts reach test, how fast
they get there, and what each one costs us to learn from.
Judgment. Run the kill/scale calls. Defend them with data, own them when they're
wrong, and keep the bar honest when a concept everyone loves isn't clearing its
numbers. **People**. Mentor and grow the product and game designers working across the
pipeline. Build the practice, not just the product. **Responsibilities*** Own the product vision, roadmap, and portfolio strategy for Gameberry's hybrid\-casual line
* Drive concepts through the full lifecycle — writing specifications and working across design, art, engineering, and UA to ship playable builds fast
* Define and defend the metrics that gate each stage of the testing funnel, and make the kill/scale decision at every gate
* Design core loops, progression systems, economies, and the meta layer that carries a title from IAA\-led to hybrid monetization
* Partner closely with UA and creative teams — in this genre, creative is product, and the two cannot be sequenced
* Own production planning, team allocation, and delivery cadence across multiple concepts running in parallel
* Present strategy, results, and honest post\-mortems to founders and senior leadership
* Mentor and guide product and game designers; raise the analytical and craft bar across the pod
* Build the operating system — playbooks, scorecards, benchmarks — so the pipeline gets better with every cycle, not just busier

 **Requirements*** 8\+ years in Product Management, with meaningful time in game development. Hybrid\-casual, hypercasual, or casual puzzle experience is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ownership of a title from concept to launch — ideally more than one, ideally including one that didn't work
* Fluency in the economics of the genre: CPI, IPM, D1/D7 retention, ARPDAU, LTV, and payback. You should be able to read a ROAS curve and say


something useful about it without an analyst in the room* Strong grasp of ad monetization and how an IAP meta layer is built on top of it
* Ability to create wireframes, product specifications, and system designs that engineers and artists can build from without a translation layer
* Strong project management skills and the ability to present work to executive staff
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed. This is a zero\-to\-one function; the process is partly yours to invent
* Self\-starter with a bias for action and a genuine love for solving unsolved problems
* Previous start\-up or studio\-building experience is a strong plus
* Working knowledge of AI tooling in the production pipeline is a plus — we're actively building this into how the team operates

 **Your Adventure at Gameberry Labs:**
At Gameberry Labs, we're all about riding the wave of new trends, tech and building the best possible player experience that shapes the gaming universe. We strive to be at the forefront of casual game entertainment. When you join us, you're stepping into a place where your ideas count and your impact matters. We offer an autonomous studio setup that fosters fast decision\-making, empowering you to make a significant impact and accelerate your professional growth. **Why Choose Us:*** Freedom to be you.
* Get in on a seriously competitive salary.
* Hungry? Enjoy free daily lunches.
* We've got your back with company\-paid health insurance.
* Team fun? It's our thing!
* Opportunity knocks with limitless growth potential.
* We're making a global splash.
* Your playground: a studio that owns the P\&L of its creations.
* Inspiring, down\-to\-earth teams are our secret sauce.
* Dive into challenges, learning, and growth at warp speed.
* We want to take India to the list of "Top 10 Gaming Studios" in the World.


Ready to embark on this thrilling quest? Join us and let's create gaming history, one
pixel at a time.

The QMSMART Safety \& Quality Specialist is the operational and functional expert for the organization's QMSMART Safety \& Quality Management System (branded internally as SQMS/ESMS). This role owns day\-to\-day use, configuration integrity, and continuous improvement of the QMSMART platform across its core modules — Occurrence Reporting, Investigation Management, Document Control, Risk Assessment, and Audit Management — while acting as the key business\-side resource during implementation phases (CRP, UAT, Data Migration, Training, Go\-Live, Hypercare) and ongoing operations.

This is a safety\-critical, regulated role (ICAO/IOSA/CAA) where accuracy, sign\-off discipline, and data integrity within QMSMART directly support the organization's Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS).

Key Responsibilities

**QMSMART Platform Ownership**

* Serve as the subject matter expert on QMSMART configuration, workflows, and module functionality (Occurrence Reporting, Investigation Management, Document Control, Risk Assessment, Audit Management).
* Maintain the role/user mapping and permissions matrix, ensuring access aligns with job function (Safety Reporter, Safety Investigator, Quality Officer, Auditor, System Admin).
* Monitor system usage and data quality; flag and resolve configuration issues or defects (using P1–P4 priority classification: P1 blocks go\-live/24h fix, P2 major/fix before UAT exit, P3 workaround exists, P4 minor/post go\-live).

**Be a Specialist and Act as a Service Manager**

* Process and triage occurrence reports; ensure timely routing for investigation per SLA.
* Support investigators with structured workflow tools, document control, and risk assessment scoring within the platform.
* Maintain audit schedules, findings, and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) tracking within the Audit Management module.
* Ensure risk assessments are logged, scored, and reviewed in line with the organization's risk matrix.

**Implementation \& Change Support**

* Act as business SME during Conference Room Piloting (CRP), validating process maps, role matrices, and test scripts.
* Coordinate or execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) test cases; track defects and support IT/vendor resolution within SLA; confirm zero open P1/P2 defects before UAT exit sign\-off.
* Support data migration validation and training material validation during Design \& Configuration.
* Contribute to Go\-Live readiness across the four pillars — Technical, Data, People, Regulatory — and support Hypercare/adoption activities post go\-live.

**Project Management**

* Manage projects end\-to\-end by Project Plan, RAID Log, Track User Acceptance tracker and be an advocate for QMSMART during project implementation
* Log and maintain risks, actions, issues, and decisions (RAID) related to QMSMART operations and project activity, using the standard RAID register format and scoring (Likelihood × Impact for risks; Urgent/High/Low/Resolved for issues).
* Provide input to Project Steering Group (PSG) status reporting — workstream updates, red/amber risks and issues, milestones, and decisions required.
* Track and report on safety performance indicators (SPIs) and quality metrics generated from QMSMART data.

**Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver or support role\-based QMSMART training (Orientation, Occurrence Reporting, Investigation Management, Document Control, Risk Assessment, Audit Management, System Admin) per the training matrix for each user group.

* Communicate role\-specific benefits (e.g., faster reporting for Safety Reporters, elimination of spreadsheets for Quality Officers) to drive user buy\-in.

* Provide support to Sales team for product demo
* Provide support for RFP preparation and delivery
* Act as a Customer support representative during monthly customer success meetings.

Required

* Good communication and ability to communicate
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in aviation safety, quality assurance, or SMS/QMS administration.
* Hands\-on experience with QMSMART or a comparable aviation SMS/QMS software platform.
* Working knowledge of ICAO Annex 19, IOSA, and applicable CAA regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with occurrence reporting, investigation management, document control, risk assessment, and audit management processes.

Preferred

* Direct experience as a UAT participant, CRP contributor, or business SME on any Safety \& Quality implementation project or exposure to Safety \& Quality System.
* Certification in SMS (IATA/ICAO SMS training) or Quality Management (ISO 9001 Lead Auditor).

title: Product Manager, Amazon Business India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Opportunity: The IN B2B market is made of 63 MM Micro \& Small Customers and 0\.5MM Medium \& Large customers together spending $400B annually. That is the market segment that the Amazon Business team is creating solutions for.  

Problem: Over the past many years, individual shoppers in India have come to appreciate the convenience, infinite selection and competitive pricing that Amazon offers.  

While Indian businesses want many of the same benefits listed above, e\-commerce is still not a preferred/ reliable purchase option for them. That is because the needs of the Indian businesses are different from that of individual shoppers and the current state of consumer\-oriented B2C platforms does not fully address the requirements of a business purchase. That is the problem that the PM team at Amazon Business intends to solve. We intend to make buying online as simple, reliable and cost\-effective for businesses as it is for individuals.  

  

This means that the PMs in Amazon Business India have to re\-look at every aspect of the customer's journey \- browsing, selection, price display, checkout, payment, delivery and returns experience and enhance them to fir the needs of the business customer. In addition, the team has to build new products \- approval workflows, GST compliance, multi\-user accounts, spend analytics reports etc. to address unique requirements of Indian business customers. We have the same complex problems, ambiguity, fast pace you see in a startup \- but contained within the larger Amazon organization.  

  

The Role: This role will own the charter to significantly improve Enterprise procurement experience by partnering with tech teams, global/IN product development teams, marketing, operations, legal, accounting, tax, and finance teams. The roadmap will be a mix of IN first innovations and of IN adaptations of global product features.  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is enthusiastic about managing challenging, ambiguous projects across multiple teams and locations. He or she is comfortable marshaling large amounts of data to make decisions and build business cases.  

  

The right candidate will share Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great customer and seller experience.
